title: InSyfy — Autonomous Research Agent
description: Designed and built a multi-agent research system on LangGraph: a planner fans out parallel web search, hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword + cross-encoder reranking) pulls from a persistent Qdrant memory, and synthesis is gated by a citation-enforcement layer that declines claims lacking sufficient evidence rather than hallucinating. Added a self-critique retry loop, real-time SSE progress streaming, and independently diagnosed and fixed concurrency and data-integrity bugs (a blocking event loop, broken event-log pagination, invalid vector-DB IDs) that don't surface in a casual demo.

title: Multimodal Sentiment Chatbot
description: Built a multi-model inference router combining cloud (SageMaker) and local (Phi-2) backends, with dynamic routing based on query complexity. Fine-tuned BERT for sequence classification on 160K labelled tweets; achieved 93% F1-score with voice input/output via STT/TTS.

title: Crop Disease Detection System
description: Achieved 96% test accuracy on a Grape Leaf Disease 4 Class using transfer learning (CNN backbone) with augmentation and fine-tuning of classification head. Deployed model behind a REST API (FastAPI) with a Streamlit dashboard for real-time image upload and inference.
